description: Landesamt für Natur, Umwelt und Klima Nordrhein-Westfalen: drinking water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Landesamt für Natur, Umwelt und Klima Nordrhein-Westfalen. Coverage: Landesamt für Natur, Umwelt und Klima Nordrhein-Westfalen. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drinking water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Datendownload - Trinkwassermessdaten 2018-2020 NRW; Datendownload - Trinkwasserversorgungsgebiete NRW; Trinkwasserversorgungsgebiete NRW; Trinkwassermessdaten 2018-2020 NRW. Formats seen: ATOM, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply), as linked on the portal listing (http://dcat-ap.de/def/licenses/dl-zero-de/2.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
